subject.title: fix(discord): messages sent during gateway reconnect are silently dropped

question: Should this PR land as the bounded reconnect-window fix while the full-outage durable recovery case remains separate?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and proven, but it intentionally changes Discord delivery retry behavior and leaves a related message-loss class to another item, so the final tradeoff is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Land bounded retry
options.body: Accept the per-request retry boundary as the narrow fix for short reconnect windows and keep the full-outage durable recovery work separate.

options.title: Wait for durable recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether both reconnect-window and full-outage recovery should land together.

recommendation.title: Land bounded retry
recommendation.body: Accept the per-request retry boundary as the narrow fix for short reconnect windows and keep the full-outage durable recovery work separate.
